data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that provides a responsive sidebar, drawer, or navigation bar for mobile, web, and desktop.
data.what_it_does: SidebarX renders a navigation sidebar that adapts to screen size. It can act as a permanent sidebar on large screens or a drawer on small screens, supporting icons, labels, hover effects, and custom actions.
use_when: You need a consistent navigation UI across mobile, web, and desktop
You want a sidebar that collapses/expands automatically
You prefer a single widget that handles both drawer and sidebar use cases
avoid_when: You need complex nested routing or deep link handling
You require a highly customized animation beyond the provided options
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Easy to use API with minimal boilerplate
Built‑in support for hover, long press, and custom icons
Responsive behavior out of the box
weaknesses: No built‑in routing integration (you must manage navigation yourself)
Limited to sidebar/drawer UI, not a full navigation framework
No support for nested routes or advanced navigation patterns
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package
